"""Combine explicitly executed successes at the same source/HAP freeze, retaining failed history."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--first',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--rerun',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
a=p.parse_args()
assert not a.out.exists()
def read(path): return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def digest(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
sources=[a.first,a.rerun]
receipts=[read(path.parent/'install-receipt.json') for path in sources]
assert receipts[0]['freeze_sha256']==receipts[1]['freeze_sha256']
assert [r['hap_sha256'] for r in receipts[0]['installations']]==[r['hap_sha256'] for r in receipts[1]['installations']]
cases=[]
for number in range(1,10):
    source=sources[0 if number<=6 else 1]
    candidates=[x for x in read(source)['cases'] if re.search(rf'\.test_c{number:02}_',x['name']) and x['outcome']=='pass']
    assert len(candidates)==1, (number,'No unique actual passed method')
    case=dict(candidates[0]);case.update({'result_path':str(source),'result_sha256':digest(source),'receipt':str(source.parent/'install-receipt.json')})
    assert Path(case['evidence_directory']).exists()
    cases.append(case)
history=[{'result':str(path),'sha256':digest(path),'cases':read(path)['cases'],'command':read(path.parent/'suite.command.json')} for path in sources]
result={'scope':'device_controlled only; representative original ArkUI/VM/repository/helper with controlled external datasource; NOT real HTTP faults', 'pass':len(cases),'fail':0,'not_run':0,'source_freeze_sha256':receipts[0]['freeze_sha256'],'actual_haps':[x['hap_sha256'] for x in receipts[0]['installations']], 'cases':cases,'history':history,'note':'C01-C06 inherited from unchanged-source first round; original C07 Host input precondition failure retained, corrected with actual-value validation and fresh reinstall; C07-C09 actually rerun. This is a per-method combination, not a claim the original nine-method run exited0.'}
a.out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'pass':len(cases),'history_retained':len(history),'out':str(a.out)}))

import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out=root/'workflow/verification/development-evidence-manifest-v5.json'
assert not out.exists()
status=json.loads((root/'workflow/verification/development-status-v5.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
dirs=set(status['case_directories'].values()) | set(status['controlled_case_directories'].values())
for result in ['logs/development/controlled-run-v1/result.json','logs/development/controlled-run-v2/result.json','logs/development/controlled-smoke-v1/result.json']:
    record=json.loads((root/result).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    for case in record['cases']:
        if case.get('evidence_directory'):
            dirs.add(Path(case['evidence_directory']).resolve().relative_to(root).as_posix())
dirs.update(['logs/development/normal-final-v1','logs/development/controlled-run-v1','logs/development/controlled-run-v2','logs/development/controlled-smoke-v1','logs/development/controlled-smoke-v2','logs/development/verification-build-v4','logs/development/device-v4','logs/development/state-v4'])
paths=set()
for relative in dirs:
    folder=root/relative
    assert folder.is_dir(),folder
    paths.update(p for p in folder.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
paths.update((root/'workflow/verification').glob('*.py'))
paths.update((root/'workflow/verification').glob('*.ps1'))
paths.update([root/'workflow/verification/development-status-v5.json',root/'workflow/verification/development-verification-v5.md',root/'workflow/verification/DEVICE_TESTS.md',root/'workflow/verification-freeze-v4.json',root/'logs/development/controlled-current-v4.json'])
for name in ['development-failure-v3.md','development-observation-failure-v4.md','development-failure-v5.md','development-observation-failure-v6.md']:
    paths.add(root/'workflow/verification'/name)
paths.update((root/'hypium_tests').glob('*.py'))
files={}
for path in sorted(paths):
    relative=path.resolve().relative_to(root).as_posix()
    files[relative]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':path.stat().st_size}
value={'utc':dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Task-local final v4 current pass evidence and preserved failed original rounds; selected critical sources/receipts/commands/scripts/packages/PNG/trees/raw logs. Not an official score or external data snapshot guarantee. Manifest excludes itself.','file_count':len(files),'files':files}
out.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'out':str(out),'files':len(files),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
